body:
New Mob.DisplayName/Label(), mob.ApplyVariant, server/mobvariant.Registry (data/mob_variants.json). Founder decided: variants inherit base Kind's drop table (Kind field untouched). apps2/mud spawns one variant per rule per zone next to a real base mob. Seeded Elder Worm/Fierce Rabbit/Bloated Leech. 9 new tests, go test ./... clean. Commit 35985f9. Live-verified: Elder Worm at 144 HP, displays and targets correctly by name.
